summary.text: Timi Brown-Powers is the Democratic candidate for Iowa State Senate District 31 in the November 3, 2026 general election.
She has represented District 61 in the Iowa House of Representatives since 2015 and is not seeking re-election to that seat.

paragraphs.text: Timi Brown-Powers was born on Beale Air Force Base in California and lives in Waterloo, Iowa.
She graduated from Hoover High School in Des Moines and earned a degree in therapeutic recreation from the University of Northern Iowa; her professional experience includes working for MercyOne.
She assumed office in the Iowa House on January 1, 2015, and advanced from the Democratic primary for State Senate District 31 on June 2, 2026.
